plugins.description: Adds packet-rate and jitter telemetry to dashboard, chart and debug log.

info.title: Debug Packets Lite
info.what: Adds packet-rate and jitter telemetry to the debug monitor.
info.how: When enabled, the debug runtime computes packet rate and jitter and extends log/chart output.
info.usage: Enable in Plugin Manager, then open Debug Dashboard and check Packet Rate/Jitter and PACKETS chart tab.
